responsibilities: Integrate source data from legacy ERP, warehouse management, PO systems, POS and third-party feeds, working within the organizations’ ingestion and governance framework.
Build and maintain dbt models across staging, intermediate and mart layers for the supply-chain domain.
Design and implement business reporting / dashboard for the Supply Chain teams to support business strategy and day-to-day operations.
Provide day-to-day operation-level data & analysis support to operation team so as to improve operational efficiency in terms of lead time, forecast, capacity & cost.
Carry out complex analysis to support business decisions (e.g. Network design, DC locations, etc.
Collaborate with Data Warehouse team (DaWaCa) to create robust and scalable data infrastructure to retrieve and analyze data.
Provide one single source of truth for Supply Chain data.
Define, recommend, and implement new key performance indicators (e.g. forecast accuracy)
Scope and create user-friendly and actionable dashboards to provide visibility and insight.
Support ERP system roll-out across different operation units.
Work with Finance team to connect operational performance (KPIs) with financial improvements.
Work with business stakeholders to fine tune end-to-end data flows.
Support Network design for different operating models and business cases.
Conduct analysis to support continuous improvement of business process and system.
Define KPIs and develop dashboards for 3PL performance.
